Hi, I hope you are fine.

I completed my Bachelor of Science (BSc) in Geography with Mathematics, Physics, and Computer Science from Jadavpur University. Then I did my Master of Science (MSc) in Geography from Jadavpur University. I am currently pursuing a PhD on the application of Polarimetry Synthetic Aperture Radar (PolSAR) in disaster management.

Code

Open tools and applications built from my research.

Google Earth Engine App

Sentinel-1 Dual-Pol Agricultural Flood Descriptor (SAFD)

A web application for mapping flood-affected agricultural fields with Sentinel-1 dual-polarimetric SAR data. It runs in the browser on Google Earth Engine, so no software installation is needed.

  1. Draw a polygon over the known flood area
  2. Set the flood event date range and find the available Sentinel-1 GRD images
  3. Choose the pre-event and post-event image dates
  4. Compare the Pre Event, Post Event and SAFD maps side by side
